title: Integrated in silico-in vitro identification of high-affinity TCR-Like antibodies targeting HPV18 E6/E7 for cervical cancer detection.
authors: Sachit, Bassam Ali; Dass, Sylvia; Rajan, Rehasri Selva; Tye, Gee Jun; Balakrishnan, Venugopal
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接分析TCR样抗体与肽-MHC复合物相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-肽-MHC结合建模，但核心是抗体-抗原识别而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate the diagnostic potential of human papillomavirus type 18 (HPV18) E6/E7-specific T cell receptor (TCR)-like antibodies for the early detection of HPV-associated cervical cancer. An integrated in silico and in vitro approach was employed, in which three fully human TCR-like antibodies (H11\Ab, E5\Ab, and G8\Ab) were analysed by molecular docking to assess antibody-peptide-major histocompatibility complex (P-MHC) class I HLA-A24:02 interactions, followed by experimental validation using SiHa and C33A cervical cancer cell lines. Docking analyses demonstrated stable, high-affinity interactions between the antibodies and their corresponding peptide-MHC complexes, consistent with experimental observations. In vitro assays confirmed strong binding specificity and functional activity in HPV18-positive cells, with no detectable reactivity in HPV-negative controls. These findings demonstrate that TCR-like antibodies targeting HPV18 E6/E7 peptide-MHC complexes enable highly specific detection of HPV-associated cervical cancer and support their potential application as early diagnostic biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估人乳头瘤病毒18型（HPV18）E6/E7特异性T细胞受体（TCR）样抗体在HPV相关宫颈癌早期检测中的诊断潜力。采用整合的计算机模拟与体外实验方法，通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 分析三种全人源TCR样抗体（H11\Ab、E5\Ab和G8\Ab）与抗体-肽-主要组织相容性复合体（P-MHC）I类HLA-A24:02的相互作用，随后使用SiHa和C33A宫颈癌细胞系进行实验验证。对接分析显示，抗体与其相应肽-MHC复合物之间存在稳定、高亲和力的相互作用，与实验观察结果一致。体外实验证实，在HPV18阳性细胞中具有强结合特异性和功能活性，而在HPV阴性对照中未检测到反应性。这些发现表明，靶向HPV18 E6/E7肽-MHC复合物的TCR样抗体能够实现HPV相关宫颈癌的高度特异性检测，并支持其作为早期诊断生物标志物的潜在应用。
